title: Father's death in 1916 and Arthur's birth in 1903
summary: Arthur gives his birth date, says his father died when he was 13 at about 52, after a hard-to-hear garbled year.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: If you don't mind to tell us as much as you can remember about your father. Do you remember when he was born, about what year and when he died? Those facts. We don't even know that.
No. He died in around, let's see, I can probably tell you just when he died. About what year? John. John. When he died, I was 13 years old when he died.
By the way, when were you born if you don't mind telling me.
John. 1903. February the 4th, 1903. I was born. And he died when I was 13 years old. That would make 13 and 3 would be... John.
John. John. That's the year he died.
And do you remember how old he was?
I think he was about 52 when he died. 52.
That's so old then. Really wasn't.
